messages.content: 在紐約現代藝術博物館找一座青銅雕像，並在巴黎羅浮宮找一座石頭雕像。同時，在大都會藝術博物館找一幅畢卡索的畫作。

function.name: book_find
function.description: Find a book in a library based on specific criteria like author, genre or publication year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: historical_landmark_find
function.description: Find historical landmarks based on specific criteria like location or era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

era.description: Era of the landmark. E.g. Middle Ages, Renaissance

function.name: artwork_find
function.description: Locate artwork in museums based on specific criteria like type of material, artist, or era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum.description: The name of the museum, e.g. Modern Arts Museum, New York

type.description: Type of the artwork. E.g. Painting, Sculpture

material.description: Material of the artwork if it's a sculpture. E.g. Bronze, Marble

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find a bronze sculpture in the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) in New York, a stone sculpture in the Louvre in Paris, and a Picasso painting in the Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met). We need to use the functions. The user didn't specify the type for the first two: "青銅雕像" means bronze sculpture, so type: Sculpture, material: Bronze. For the second: stone sculpture, material: Stone. For the third: painting by Picasso. So we need to call artwork_find for each. The function signature: artwork_find({museum, type, material?, artist?}). For the first: museum: "Modern Arts Museum, New York" (but the actual name is "Museum of Modern Art" or "MoMA"). The user said "紐約現代藝術博物館" which is "New York Museum of Modern Art". So museum: "Museum of Modern Art, New York". type: "Sculpture". material: "Bronze". For second: museum: "Louvre, Paris". type: "Sculpture". material: "Stone". For third: museum: "Metropolitan Museum of Art". type: "Painting". artist: "Picasso". No material needed.

We need to call the function three times. The tool expects a single call? We can call multiple times. We'll produce three calls. The function returns any. We'll output the results.
